info.title: Silah Cloud Platform API
info.description: Production REST API for the Silah personal dashboard. Consumed by the Next.js web app (cookie session) and native Android / Windows / iOS clients (bearer token). All endpoints are user-scoped; ownership is enforced server-side. See /docs/API.md for the full human-readable contract and /docs/NATIVE_CLIENT_GUIDE.md for native client integration.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Token exchange, refresh, logout, and current-user profile

tags.name: Sync
tags.description: Delta sync: pull, push, and status

get.description: Returns API metadata, sync entity list, and documentation links. No authentication required.
Lightweight liveness + database probe. Returns 503 if the database is unreachable. Safe to call unauthenticated; never exposes secrets.

post.summary: Exchange a Google ID token for Silah tokens
post.description: Native clients call this after obtaining a Google ID token from the platform Sign-In SDK. The server verifies the ID token with Google, upserts the User and Device, and issues an access token (15 min JWT) + refresh token (30 day opaque). This endpoint does not require authentication.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new access token
post.description: The refresh token is opaque (not a JWT). Its SHA-256 hash is looked up in ApiToken; if not revoked or expired, a new access token is issued. The refresh token itself is not rotated in v1.

401.description: Refresh token invalid, revoked, or expired

error.message: Refresh token has expired — please re-authenticate

post.summary: Revoke a refresh token, device, or all devices
post.description: Accepts one of three mutually-exclusive bodies: `{ refreshToken }`, `{ deviceId }`, `{ allDevices: true }`. With no body, revokes the calling bearer token's device. Requires authentication.

204.description: No content (cookie caller with no body)

get.description: Returns the user's profile plus auth-context metadata (`authMethod`, `deviceId`).
Returns devices owned by the current user, most-recently-seen first.

post.description: Upserts a device by (userId, deviceId). Rarely needed — POST /auth/token does this automatically on login.

delete.description: Sets revokedAt = now(). The device row remains in the database for audit; its tokens are invalidated.

get.summary: Pull sync events since a cursor
get.description: Returns all SyncEvents with seq > cursor, in ascending seq order. Use nextCursor for the next pull. If hasMore is true, immediately issue another pull. cursor=0 (or omitted) triggers a full sync from the beginning.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The last seq the client has applied (BigInt as string). 0 or omitted = full pull.

parameters.name: collections
parameters.description: Comma-separated entity plural names to limit the pull (e.g. 'tasks,contacts'). Unknown names are dropped.

post.description: Push up to 100 offline changes. Each change must include a unique operationId (UUID) for idempotency. Each change is its own transaction; per-change results are returned. Conflicts are detected via baseVersion mismatch.

get.summary: Get sync metadata for the current user
get.description: Returns the latestSeq, eventCount, perEntity breakdown, and the calling device's info.

bearerAuth.description: Silah-issued access token (HS256 JWT, 15 min TTL). Obtain via POST /auth/token. Send as: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie. Used automatically by the Next.js web app — native clients use bearerAuth instead.

Sort.name: sort
Sort.description: Sort field. Prefix with '-' for descending (e.g. '-createdAt'). Unknown fields fall back to the entity's default sort.

Search.name: search
Search.description: Case-insensitive 'contains' search across the entity's whitelisted searchable fields.

DateFrom.name: dateFrom
DateFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound on the entity's date field (or createdAt if no date field). ISO 8601.

DateTo.name: dateTo
DateTo.description: Inclusive upper bound on the entity's date field (or createdAt if no date field). ISO 8601.

IncludeDeleted.name: includeDeleted
IncludeDeleted.description: Set to 'true' to include soft-deleted records in list responses.

Force.name: force
Force.description: Set to 'true' to hard-delete instead of soft-delete.

error.message: Access token is invalid or expired
This device has been revoked. Please re-authenticate.

NotFound.description: Resource not found or not owned by the caller

error.message: Version conflict — the record was modified by another client

details.strategy: Pull the latest version and retry your change.

ValidationError.description: Request body failed Zod schema validation

details.title: String must contain at least 1 character(s)

BadRequest.description: Malformed request (non-JSON body, invalid Google ID token, etc.)

error.message: Invalid or expired Google ID token

idToken.description: Google ID token from the platform Sign-In SDK.

refreshToken.description: Opaque 32-byte base64url string, 30 day TTL. Returned once — store securely.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

payload.description: Full record after the change, or {id, deletedAt} for deletes.

nextCursor.description: BigInt as string. Use as the cursor for the next pull.

error.description: Present (non-null) only when the cursor was invalid; events will be empty.

baseVersion.description: For update: the version the client last saw. If omitted, no version check.

payload.description: Record fields. For create/update must conform to the entity's schema. For delete, omit.

soft.description: true for soft-delete, false for hard delete (?force=true).

listTasks.description: Returns tasks owned by the current user. Supports pagination, filtering, sorting, search, date-range, and includeDeleted.
